items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the public service law, the public authorities law, and the real property law, in relation to green jobs-green New York on-bill financing
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S7565

 TITLE OF BILL :
An act to amend the public service law, the public authorities law,
and the real property law, in relation to green jobs-green New York
on-bill financing


 PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL :
To establish an on-bill financing program for the "Green Jobs/Green
New York" program established in chapter 487 of the laws of 2009.

 SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS :
Section one provides definitions for the Green Jobs/Green New York
on-bill financing program.

Section 3 amends the public service law to exempt the Green Jobs-Green
New York on-bill financing charge from the utility assessments
provided for by section 18-a of the public service law.

Section 5 amends the public service law to provide for the Green
Jobs-Green New York on bill financing charge fund in the joint custody
of the Comptroller and the Commissioner of Taxation and Finance.

Section 6 amends the public authorities law to provide NYSERDA with
some parameters for on-bill financing.

Section 7 amends the public authorities law to provide the Power
Authority with authority to establish an on-bill financing system.

Section 8 amends the public authorities law to provide the Long Island
Power Authority with authority to establish an on-bill financing
system.

Section 9 amends the real property law to provide for disclosures
concerning on-bill financing and green jobs-green New York retrofits.

 JUSTIFICATION :

By enacting a "Green Jobs/Green New York" program in 2009, the state
authorized the performance of energy-efficient retrofits at no initial
cost to residential property owners, with an ultimate goal of
improving large numbers of residential units over the next five years,
and demonstrating the effectiveness of innovative financing mechanisms
in reaching this goal.

Installation of energy efficiency improvements to reduce the loss or
waste of energy is a proven method of reducing a city, region or
state's carbon footprint, and of lowering energy costs for households.
Weatherization has similar effects and, more importantly, gives rise
to large numbers of jobs and can serve as a gateway for green collar
career paths.

The Green Jobs-Green New York (GJ-GNY) program will create green
collar jobs and career paths in New York. It will also help the state
to reduce its dependence on fossil fuels, lead to lower housing costs,
and support community development. One of the key factors to the
success of GJ-GNY is the method of financing the energy
efficiency/weatherization improvements to the properties affected
under the program. In order to attract the broadest possible variety
of financing, and private sector involvement, the authorization of
on-bill financing is a necessary piece of the program. This
legislation further provides for authorization of on-bill financing,
and provides parameters within which it will function.

 PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
None.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS FOR STATE AND LOCAL GOVERNMENTS :
None.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect immediately.
